title: Docker client created per HTTP request in daemon API
description: internal/daemon/api.go lines 134, 228, 263: Each API handler creates a new Docker client with docker.NewClient(). Docker client creation involves connecting to the Docker socket. Should create one client at daemon startup and share it across handlers.

title: Implement story pattern (begin/success/fail) logging
close_reason: Story pattern (begin/success/fail) implemented in docker/client.go, reconcile/deploy.go, reconcile/git.go, manifest/render.go, alert/alert.go with timing and error context

title: Standardize config loading patterns
close_reason: Config loading pattern established: config.Load() as main entry, loadConfigFile/loadXConfig helpers for subsystems, env var overrides. Used consistently in config.go and daemon.go

title: lock and snapshot packages use Unix-only syscalls without build tags
description: internal/lock/lock.go uses syscall.Flock (Unix-only) and internal/snapshot/snapshot.go uses syscall.Statfs_t/Statfs (Unix-only), but neither file has build tags. The reconcile package correctly handles this with lock_unix.go and lock_windows.go. These packages will fail to compile on Windows.

title: Add structured logging to manifest template rendering
close_reason: Added structured logging to RenderService and RenderStack with provision loading and error tracking

title: Legacy Python pyproject.toml created in init wizard
description: internal/cmd/init.go lines 149-153: The init wizard creates a pyproject.toml file as part of project scaffolding. This is a legacy artifact from when bosun was a Python project. Bosun is now a Go binary and pyproject.toml is misleading.

title: N+1 ContainerInspect calls in ListContainers for health status
description: internal/docker/client.go: ListContainers calls ContainerInspect once per container to get health status. With many containers this causes N+1 API calls. Should use the docker API list options to include health status in the initial list response, or batch the inspect calls.

title: Add input validation to webhook handlers
close_reason: Added maxWebhookBodySize (1MB) limit using io.LimitReader in all webhook handlers

title: Hand-rolled JSON output in printStatusJSON instead of encoding/json
description: internal/cmd/status.go lines 126-153: printStatusJSON manually constructs JSON via string concatenation with a custom escapeJSON helper function. This is error-prone (missing escapes, wrong structure). Should use encoding/json.Marshal or a struct with json tags.

close_reason: Manifest package already has 8 test files with 84.6% coverage. Added tests for nil merge cases in merge_test.go during this session

title: validateStackFile always returns true (validation is a no-op)
description: internal/cmd/diagnostics.go: validateStackFile always returns true regardless of input. The function body only returns true with no actual validation logic. This means the doctor/lint commands silently pass invalid stack files.

title: Add logging for Twilio partial failures
close_reason: Added logging for individual SMS failures and partial delivery summary in twilio.go Send method

title: Config file parsed independently 4 times on startup
description: internal/config/config.go: The config file is read and parsed 4 separate times via loadConfigFile, loadInfraContainers, loadTunnelConfig, and loadAlertConfig. Each does independent file I/O and YAML parsing. Should parse once and extract sections from the parsed structure.

close_reason: Context cancellation added to daemon Run() initial delay using select with ctx.Done(), pollLoop() checks ctx.Done(), reconcile operations pass context through

title: Raw ANSI escape code in ui.Debug instead of fatih/color
description: internal/ui/color.go line 81: Debug function uses raw ANSI escape \033[90m instead of the fatih/color library used everywhere else in the package. Should use color.New(color.FgHiBlack) for consistency and proper terminal detection.

close_reason: Added structured logging to Backup, DeployLocal, DeployRemote, ComposeUpMultiple, and ComposeUpMultipleWithRollback functions

close_reason: Added WaitGroup tracking for goroutines in Run(), pollLoop tracked, shutdown waits for completion

close_reason: Audit trail implemented: Warn-level logs for emergency operations (overboard, rollback, restore) in emergency.go, security events in server.go webhook handlers

title: PollInterval parsing bug appends 's' to already-valid duration strings
description: internal/daemon/daemon.go lines 558-567: The PollInterval parsing logic appends 's' to the env var value unconditionally, turning a valid duration like '30s' into '30ss' which fails to parse. Should check if the value already contains a duration suffix before appending.

close_reason: Added Warn-level security logging for signature validation failures with remote_addr/endpoint context

title: Diff mode placeholder in provision command
description: internal/cmd/provision.go line 414: showDiff function prints 'Diff mode not yet implemented' and returns nil. The --diff flag is accepted but does nothing useful. Should either implement diff functionality or remove the flag until it's ready.

title: Add observability with metrics and tracing
Standardize ui.* vs structured log.* usage patterns
close_reason: Pattern established: ui.* for user-facing console output, log.* for structured logging. Applied consistently in daemon.go, server.go, and throughout codebase

title: Unsafe capitalizeFirst panics on non-lowercase ASCII input
description: internal/cmd/comms.go line 268: capitalizeFirst does s[0]-32 which is raw ASCII arithmetic that only works for lowercase a-z. Passing a digit, symbol, already-uppercase letter, or unicode character will produce garbage or panic. Should use unicode.ToUpper(rune(s[0])) or strings.ToUpper(s[:1]).

title: Add request/response logging for external API calls
close_reason: Request/response logging added to Discord, SendGrid, and Twilio providers with status codes, error messages, and durations

title: GitLab webhook token uses plain string comparison (timing attack)
description: internal/cmd/webhook.go line 293 validates GitLab tokens with plain string comparison (token != h.secret) instead of crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare. This is susceptible to timing attacks that could leak the secret token byte-by-byte. The TCP server already uses constant-time comparison correctly (internal/daemon/tcp.go).

title: Replace stderr writes with structured logging in snapshot
close_reason: Replaced fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr) calls with structured log.Warn() in snapshot package

title: validateServiceFile uses fragile strings.Contains for YAML validation
description: internal/cmd/diagnostics.go: validateServiceFile validates YAML by checking strings.Contains for 'name:' and 'compose:'. This is extremely fragile - it matches comments, string values, and nested keys. Should parse YAML and check the structure properly.

close_reason: Added sync.Mutex to protect file field in Lock struct, Acquire and Release now thread-safe for concurrent goroutine access

title: SSH InsecureIgnoreHostKey bypasses host key verification
description: internal/reconcile/git.go lines 115 and 142 use ssh.InsecureIgnoreHostKey() which disables SSH host key verification entirely. This makes git operations vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks. Should use known_hosts file or at minimum warn the user. Security issue - P1.

close_reason: Replaced hardcoded paths with configurable constants (DefaultSocketPath, DefaultLockFile); Added comprehensive documentation for alerting and logging

title: Hand-rolled metrics placeholder in daemon server
description: internal/daemon/server.go: The server has hand-rolled atomic counter metrics that are a placeholder. Should be replaced with proper Prometheus metrics per the project standards (SHOULD expose /metrics endpoint). Related to existing beads issue bosun-bfz.

title: Custom jsonReaderType reimplements bytes.NewReader
description: internal/daemon/client.go line 196: Defines a custom jsonReaderType struct that wraps a byte slice and implements io.Reader. This is functionally identical to bytes.NewReader from the standard library. Should use bytes.NewReader directly.

title: stdlib log.Printf used instead of zerolog in chart.go
description: internal/manifest/chart.go lines 58-61: Uses stdlib log.Printf for logging instead of the project's zerolog-based internal/log package. All other packages consistently use zerolog. Should be converted to log.Warn() or log.Debug() calls.

title: Hardcoded getVersion() returns 'dev' instead of using build-time version
description: internal/daemon/daemon.go line 519: getVersion() returns hardcoded 'dev' instead of using the version variable set via ldflags at build time. The root command already has proper version injection via ldflags. This means the daemon always reports version 'dev' in health/status endpoints.
